note: Decision 266: Strain — what the world does to your head, beside HP. 0–10; bands give a TN penalty on skill checks (not attacks). Gains come from the app (dropping below half HP, a fumble, a crewmate going down, debt at its worst when a mission starts) or the GM's button; a Mental Strength roll halves one (rounded down). At the maximum: a breaking point (a d6 on the table below; a Scar rolls a second d6), then Strain drops to afterBreak. Relief: a safe new scene −1, a crewmate's Steady (more when the crew is Tight), downtime by its length plus a better home. Scars last until the owner decides otherwise.

results.text: You freeze. The world goes very far away for a moment.
You lash out — at the nearest thing, or person. The GM says what that costs.
You bolt: away from it, by the shortest way out, until someone stops you or you reach cover.
You hear your name in the static. Nobody else did.
You lose ten minutes you can't account for. Your hands are steady now. Too steady.
It leaves a mark: roll for a Scar.

list.text: The hum of fridges, servers and substations sets your teeth on edge.
You don't sleep with the lights off any more.
You count exits. Every room, every time, out loud if you're tired.
You turn screens face down. You don't like what looks back.
Your hands shake until something goes wrong. Then they're very still.
Sometimes you answer a voice nobody else heard.
